interpretation: The clean/control/break action separation term can penalize identical correct prefixes before the task-relevant branch. This is a toy algebraic counterexample, not evidence that BAS-VLA trains incorrectly or that a new method works.
required_followups: Construct matched manipulation tasks with independently annotated earliest semantic divergence time.
Compare rollout outcomes, not only action distance.
Include BAS-VLA and standard behavioral cloning as baselines.
Test one-to-many valid actions and no-common-prefix controls.
